newsitem.title: USA: Smith acquires assets, sees earnings boost.
newsitem.headline: Smith acquires assets, sees earnings boost.

text.p: Smith International Inc said Tuesday it had acquired the assets of Faster Oilfield Services Inc, a Canadian operator of a downhole drilling products manufacturing and repair center for the oil and gas industry.
Smith said the acquisition, which became effective July 25, should "have a positive impact on earnings and cash flow immediately."
Smith International shares were trading up 1-5/16 early Tuesday afternoon at 70-1/8.
Faster Oilfield had annual revenues of about $4.5 million and will become part of the Smith Drilling & Completions business unit.
Smith said the acquisition expands its manufacturing and repair capabilities in Canada.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed, and a Smith company spokesman could not be immediately reached.

Smith International supplies premium products and services to the oil and gas exploration and production industry through five principal business units: M-I - Fluids, M-I - Swaco, Smith Tool, Smith Diamond Technology, and Smith Drilling & Completions.
